## Objective
- Build and expand the Sandevistan 3D baseplate game prototype with weapons and monster waves.

## Requirements
- User requested: “make a game little bigger and add weapons and monster waves”.

## Decisions
- The original prototype is a self-contained canvas game in `index.html`; existing combat includes a dash strike and time dilation.
- No implementation choices for the requested expansion have been completed yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the initial playable prototype in `index.html` with an isometric arena, pickups, sentries, time dilation, jump, dash strike, and keyboard/touch controls.
- Validated embedded JavaScript syntax and captured an opening-screen screenshot.

### Active
- Expand the game world and implement weapons plus successive monster waves.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Enlarge the playable arena and adjust camera/render bounds to match.
2. Add usable weapon combat and controls, including appropriate enemy-hit feedback.
3. Replace or augment the static enemy setup with escalating monster waves and update HUD/objectives accordingly.
4. Verify syntax and gameplay in a browser.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Current complete game implementation; arena, combat, enemies, HUD, input, and overlay are all here.

- Changes are uncommitted.
